summary: Tested Vector SaaS new onboarding features: 3-step onboarding flow, landing page changes (dashboard screenshot, no testimonials, 'Unlock Access' CTAs), and auth page (Google/Microsoft/Email, no GitHub). Backend APIs working correctly. Found 1 frontend bug: email registration redirects to /dashboard instead of /onboarding due to race condition in AuthPage.js.

ui_bugs.issue: New user email registration redirects to /dashboard instead of /onboarding. Race condition: lines 28-31 check isAuthenticated and call navigate('/dashboard') during render, which fires before navigate('/onboarding') on line 68 after registerWithEmail sets user state.
ui_bugs.fix_suggestion: Remove or modify lines 28-31 to not redirect authenticated users during render, or check onboarding status before redirecting to /dashboard

action_items: FIX REQUIRED: AuthPage.js lines 28-31 - The isAuthenticated check during render causes new users to redirect to /dashboard before navigate('/onboarding') executes. Either: (1) Remove the isAuthenticated check and only rely on post-auth navigation, or (2) Check onboarding-status API and redirect accordingly, or (3) Use a flag to track if registration just completed and skip the redirect
critical_code_review_comments: AuthPage.js lines 28-31: Race condition where isAuthenticated triggers navigate('/dashboard') before the registration flow can navigate to /onboarding. This breaks the requirement that new email registrations should go to onboarding.

rca_of_issue.bug: Email registration redirects to /dashboard instead of /onboarding
rca_of_issue.root_cause: In AuthPage.js, lines 28-31 have an isAuthenticated check that runs on every render. When registerWithEmail() succeeds and sets the user state (making isAuthenticated=true), React re-renders the component. During this re-render, the isAuthenticated check fires and calls navigate('/dashboard') BEFORE the async handleEmailSubmit function reaches line 68 (navigate('/onboarding')). This is a classic React state update race condition.
reproduction_steps: 2. Click 'Sign up' to switch to registration mode
6. User is redirected to /dashboard instead of /onboarding
rca_of_issue.mitigation: Modify AuthPage.js to either: (a) Remove the isAuthenticated redirect during render and handle all navigation explicitly after auth actions, or (b) Add a check for user.onboarded status before deciding where to redirect, or (c) Use a ref/flag to prevent redirect during registration flow
